question: PyMuPDF benchmark parsing 50 page PDF execution time

sources.title: GitHub - SeanLikesData/parser-bench: PDF parser benchmarking suite ...
sources.snippet: Adding a test document Drop a PDF into docs/standard/ or docs/hard/, then add a test definition to parser_bench/tests.py. Standard tests check content accuracy via expected phrases. Hard tests check specific quality dimensions: reading order, column separation, numeric extraction, table row integrity, and watermark filtering.
